title: Subsets
description:
Given an integer array nums of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set).
The solution set must not contain duplicate subsets. Return each subset with elements in ascending order, and return the outer list in lexicographic ascending order.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3]
Output: [[],[1],[1,2],[1,2,3],[1,3],[2],[2,3],[3]]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: nums = [0]
Output: [[],[0]]
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= nums.length <= 10
- -10 <= nums[i] <= 10
- All the numbers of nums are unique.

## Output Contract

Return all subsets with elements in ascending order and the outer list in lexicographic ascending order.
